strategy.title: Sell subcontracted cold-chain prescription delivery to the county's independent pharmacies, fulfilled by MedCourier LLC
strategy.why: Every chain link is on the card. Reach: published business emails to the 35 county pharmacy owners, linking to the offer page. Demand: a signal dated 2026-11-24. Price: $180, evidenced. Conversion: measured on this offer's own page, the page the email links to, at 22 money-committed pre-orders from 200 unique visitors (11%). That is the offer's own record, not a transfer. Volume: each pharmacy ships 20 temperature-controlled deliveries a week, about 85 in the window, and the need repeats. Fulfilment: MedCourier LLC quoted at $95 with $0 exposure. Settlement: 7 days to usable cash. 18 deliveries ($3,240 collected, the contract's settled-cash metric) need about 4 buying pharmacies at the measured rate to place about 5 deliveries each, roughly 6% of each one's evidenced volume. Even if only half the emailed owners visit, 2 buyers would need about 9 each (about 11%). The courier is paid only out of settled receipts.

alternatives.title: 36 deals to cover a net-of-courier reading
alternatives.why: Dropped: the contract measures settled cash collected, which 18 x $180 = $3,240 meets, and doubling the deliveries asks more of each buying pharmacy than the plan needs to.

review.reasons: EXECUTABLE at 18 deals is supported by the card. Reach: published business emails to the 35 county pharmacy owners, linking to the offer page. Demand: a current signal dated 2026-11-24. Price: an evidenced $180 for this buyer. Conversion: Brain's basis is this offer's own inbound page (22/200, 11%), the same page the email links to, so it is the offer's own record, not a transfer. Volume: 20 deliveries a week per pharmacy, about 85 each in the window, and the need recurs. 18 deliveries need about 5 from each of about 4 buyers, or about 9 each if only 2 buy; both are a small share of evidenced volume. Fulfilment: MedCourier LLC, quoted at $95 with $0 exposure, performs the delivery as the card's recorded fulfiller. Settlement: 7 days. The ledger checks: 18 x $180 = $3,240 collected on day 10, settled on day 17, inside 30 days, meeting the SETTLED_CASH (collected) target. MedCourier's $1,710 is paid on day 17 from settled receipts. Exposure is $0, Brain's check reports no problems, and nothing unknown is treated as known. The SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE connectors must be connected before day 1; that is readiness, not a chain gap.
